notes: The supplied *Lord* at t013 was marked `added` on rule 103's repeated-predicate-nominal clause. It stands inside the phrase the article ὁ governs, where no noun is expressed and αὐτός already has *same*, so rule 102 gives the article the determiner and the supplied nominal together and rule 103's own article carve-out says nothing is `added`. Recurrence of κύριος in the predicate is not the test, as rule 103 states in terms. This also removes a chapter-internal split against ROM.10.15, where the same shape (τὰ ἀγαθά → *good things*) folds the supplied nominal into the article.
